q1_indexed_trend: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: 30-day counts; each series divided by its 2019 value.
q1_deaths_30d: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash.
q1_rates: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024. Definition: DGT published rates; fleet = registered vehicles, 30-day deaths.
q1_monthly_heatmap: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: 30-day deaths in the month as a share of the year.
q1_deaths_by_zone: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash. n = 875,013.
q2_hour_weekday_crashes: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024 pooled. Definition: count of injury crashes. n = 875,013.
q2_hour_weekday_fatal_share: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024 pooled. Definition: fatal crashes (30 days) divided by all injury crashes. n = 875,013.
q2_night_share: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: darkness = lighting codes 4–6 (no daylight, with or without street lighting); 30-day deaths. n = 875,013.
q2_hour_band_road_group: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024 pooled. Definition: fatal crashes (30 days) divided by all injury crashes. n = 875,013.
q5_road_user_shares: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024, all roads. Definition: 30-day deaths by the vehicle the person was using; trucks, buses, other and unspecified folded together; personal mobility vehicles counted separately only from 2020. n = 875,013.
q5_driver_deaths: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: drivers only, 30-day deaths; PMV series starts in 2020.
q5_pedestrian_deaths: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash.
q4_province_deaths: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población. Period: 2024. Definition: 30-day deaths in the province where the crash happened, divided by residents on 1 July; exact Poisson 95% intervals, wide where deaths are few. n = 1,785.
q4_national_rates: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población; DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025. Period: 2002–2024 (residents), 2014–2024 (licence holders). Definition: 30-day deaths of all road users; residents on 1 July; licence holders at the census date.
q7_ladder_ratio: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población; DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025; ESRA 2018 and 2023 (Spain), MOVILIA 2006. Period: 2014–2024. Definition: driver deaths (30 days) per unit of each denominator, 65+ divided by 35–64; shaded bands are 95% intervals from the death counts; drivers with unknown age excluded.
q7_licence_travel_share: Source: DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025; INE, Estadística Continua de Población; ESRA 2018 and 2023 (Spain), MOVILIA 2006. Period: 2024. Definition: licence holders divided by residents; travel-weighted share = ESRA national share of adults who drive spread by the MOVILIA 2006 car-travel profile, capped at the licence share.
q7_death_rates_by_band: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025; ESRA 2018 and 2023 (Spain), MOVILIA 2006. Period: 2014–2024. Definition: driver deaths within 30 days (interurban and urban) divided by licence holders and by travel-weighted drivers of the same age band; same scale on every panel.
q7_involvement_fragility: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; DGT, Censo de conductores 2014–2025. Period: 2014–2024. Definition: left: drivers involved in injury crashes per 10,000 licence holders of the band; right: driver deaths per 1,000 drivers involved (fragility and crash severity).
q7_victims_by_age: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024; INE, Estadística Continua de Población. Period: 2002–2024. Definition: all road users killed within 30 days, by age band, divided by residents on 1 July.
q6_rates_per_km: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; DGT, Kilómetros recorridos estimados a partir de la ITV 2022. Period: 2022. Definition: vehicles of each type involved in injury crashes and in 30-day fatal crashes, and their drivers and passengers killed within 30 days, divided by the type's estimated vehicle-kilometres (registered fleet × mean annual km from ITV odometer readings); whiskers are exact 95% Poisson intervals; rows ordered by fatal-crash involvement. n = 151,542 vehicles involved.
q6_per_vehicle_vs_per_km: Source: DGT, Accidentes con víctimas, tablas estadísticas 2014–2024; DGT, Kilómetros recorridos estimados a partir de la ITV 2022. Period: 2022. Definition: vehicles of each type involved in 30-day fatal crashes per 100,000 registered vehicles (left) and per billion vehicle-km (right); the lines show how each type's rank moves when distance driven replaces fleet size as the denominator.
q6_km_by_age: Source: DGT, Kilómetros recorridos estimados a partir de la ITV 2022. Period: 2022. Definition: mean annual km per vehicle, modelled from annualised ITV odometer readings and imputed to the registered fleet; valid for aggregates, not for individual vehicles. n = 32,522,330 vehicles.
q6_occupant_deaths: Source: DGT, Series históricas del Anuario de Accidentes 2024. Period: 1993–2024, all roads. Definition: deaths within 30 days of the crash, drivers and passengers of each vehicle type; panels have their own scales; personal mobility vehicles are counted from 2020.
q3_forest_fatal: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: logistic regression of at least one death on the circumstances shown plus year; odds ratios against the reference level (hollow marker) with 95% intervals clustered by province. n = 875,013.
q3_forest_serious: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: logistic regression of death or hospitalisation on the circumstances shown plus year; odds ratios against the reference level (hollow marker) with 95% intervals clustered by province. n = 875,013.
q3_calibration: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: fitted on 2016–2022, scored on 2023–2024. Definition: crashes grouped into ten equal bands of predicted probability; the dotted line is perfect calibration. n = 203,302.
q3_year_stability: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024, one fit per year. Definition: the ten largest effects of the full fatal-outcome model, each refitted on one year of crashes; shaded bands are 95% intervals.
q3_predicted_grid: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: model of 2016–2024, predictions for 2024. Definition: every other circumstance at its reference level (side collision, two vehicles, not at a junction, clear, dry, weekday, 10:00–13:59; interurban zone for interurban road types).
data_missingness: Source: DGT, Ficheros de microdatos de accidentes con víctimas 2016–2024. Period: 2016–2024. Definition: observed = not empty, not 999 (not specified), not 998 (not applicable) and not an explicit unknown code. n = 875,013.
